name: Hulagu and the fall of Baghdad
summary: Möngke's brother leads a Mongol army west to subdue the Ismaili fortresses and the Abbasid caliphate. Baghdad falls in 1258 and the last caliph is killed; the advance is stopped by the Mamluks at ʿAyn Jālūt. The Ilkhanate he founds becomes a meeting place of Persian, Chinese and European learning.

stops.note: Hulagu sets out with siege engineers from China.
The city is sacked and the caliph al-Mustaʿsim put to death.
Nasir al-Din al-Tusi's observatory is founded under Mongol patronage.
The Mamluks of Egypt defeat the Mongol rearguard.
